summary: Verified full removal of Aadhaar/Medical from SOS broadcast payload (LiveJourney), dealer Shared Emergency Data (DealerDashboard), and backend incident endpoints. Backend: 3 pytest tests pass (POST /api/incidents, GET /api/dealer/incidents, GET /api/dealer/incidents/{id}) confirming shared_data keys are strictly {phone, holder, contacts} and no 'aadhaar'/'medical' anywhere in responses even after seeding an 'Aadhaar Card' document for the rider. Frontend: SOS dialog on /app/journey/live shows only Rider Phone, Location, Contacts rows; dealer detail modal on /dealer shows only Rider Phone, Location, Family Contacts.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: /api/claims still uses 'aadhaar' in data_package (server.py:592). This is out of the requested scope (Aadhaar removal only from dealer command center and SOS broadcast) but if the product intent is to fully purge Aadhaar handling from the app, the claim package should also be revisited.
test_credentials: Seeded rider session_token=testtoken123 (user_id=usr_test1); seeded dealer session_token=dealertoken123 (user_id=usr_test_dealer1, role=dealer).
seed_data_creation: Seeded rider user+session+contact+vehicle and a dealer user+session directly in Mongo. Journey and SOS incident created via API for UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Aadhaar/Medical are fully removed from incident shared_data (backend) and from both SOS panel (LiveJourney.jsx) and dealer detail modal (DealerDashboard.jsx). Only remaining 'aadhaar' string is in POST /api/claims data_package builder (out of scope). Reusable pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/test_sos_no_aadhaar.py.
